# Lintel

> Rust desktop framework with a small public facade, native iced UI, embedded CEF WebViews, managed windows and optional services. Reuses the extracted implementation and dependencies.

## Read first
- [Project and quick starts](README.md)
- [Repository working rules](AGENTS.md)
- [Machine-readable framework catalog](lintel.project.json)
- [Implemented capabilities and platform limits](docs/capabilities.md)
- [Runtime, plugins, queues and task ownership](docs/runtime.md)
- [AI development and application contract](docs/ai-native.md)

## Application paths
- Native UI: `lintel::application` / `lintel::multi_window`, typed State/Message/update/view.
- Contextual native startup: `application_with_context` / `multi_window_with_context`, fallible initialization after services start.
- Web UI: `lintel::webview_app`, embedded pages and typed/async commands.
- Optional agent tools: feature `agent`; provider-neutral tool catalog, explicit grants, typed handlers, bounded progress and scoped cancellation.
- Optional crash reports: feature `crash-reports` and `.crash_reports(config)` register `lintel::crash_reports::CrashReports` for local reports, snapshots and upload policy. See [Crash reports](docs/capabilities.md#崩溃报告插件) and [the example](examples/crash_reports.rs).
- [Context initialization](docs/context-initialization.md)
- [Application agent tools](docs/agent-tools.md)
- [Native service API](crates/lintel-desktop/README.md)
- [Menu accessibility](docs/menu-accessibility.md)

## Tooling and delivery
- `lintel describe --json` emits the embedded schema-versioned project catalog. It does not probe the machine, build, download or execute application content.
- `lintel new` creates a portable consumer project with its own agent entry notes.
- `lintel bundle` and `lintel run` accept explicit `--crash-uploader PATH` and `--snapshot-helper PATH` executable inputs.
- [CLI discovery contract](docs/cli-describe.md)
- [Windows portable bundles](docs/windows-bundles.md)
- [Signed offline distribution](docs/windows-distribution.md)
- [Signed updater](docs/updater.md)

## Constraints
- Enable only the needed features. Keep business code on the public facade.
- Hosted/native callbacks are bounded and do not execute UI business code on arbitrary threads.
- Code availability, model tests, cross-target checks and native acceptance are different claims.
- Windows CEF native sandbox/bootstrap execution remains gated; do not infer it from API_ONLY.
- Agent discovery is not execution permission. No model vendor, network transport or shell is connected by default.
- AI Dev Loop is disabled unless explicitly requested. Ignore dependency caches and historical probes during code discovery.

- [Multi-process services](docs/multiprocess.md): optional Mojo SDK, typed workers, builder lifecycle and CLI packaging.

- [WebView service integration](docs/webview-services.md): weak page command context, browser-only initialization and typed Mojo worker calls.
